scope: FINAL_EVALUATION_ONLY; never serving prompts, admission catalogue, response cache, index enrichment or tuning
holdout_definition: Questions and expected fact combinations authored after serving freeze. Original v1 suite is regression after general pipeline repairs. Facts overlap previously reviewed manual scopes; this is question/composition holdout, not held-out source or blinded benchmark.

metrics.answerable_coverage: F01-F06 supported and appropriately cited / 6; abstentions and system errors are misses
metrics.unsupported_claims: Independent original-page review counts unsupported technical claims separately from answerable coverage
metrics.fault_cases: F11 is an injected provider failure excluded from factual denominator; no real outage claim
metrics.prerequisite_followup: F07/F10 require existing exact typed controller fixture preconditions; raw text is not permission to seed facts

cases.rider_question: For trip planning, tell me the petrol type and maximum ethanol blend the book permits, plus the nominal tank size. Is that volume an exact guaranteed fill?
forbidden_claims: 17 L guaranteed fill regardless of conditions

cases.rider_question: I am just learning the bike layout: what voltage, amp-hour rating and battery technology does the book specify, and where is the battery located?
forbidden_claims: offer removal step without complete required sequence

cases.rider_question: Reading the legend only, compare the cooling fan fuse and the horn fuse: what identifiers, colours and ratings does each have?
When the battery has been disconnected, what happens to the displayed clock, and is its time format twelve-hour or twenty-four-hour?
I am unfamiliar with the USB connection: is it a data connection, and what should I do with its cover when nothing is plugged in?
expected_facts: cap must be closed and locked properly when not used
do not leave cap open or partially closed; short-circuit risk
mandatory_warnings: do not leave cap open or partially closed when unused

cases.rider_question: After a cold start, what minimum idle time does the owner book require before accelerating, and what idle rpm does the specification list?
expected_facts: at least 120 seconds idling after start, especially cold, to circulate oil and warm engine
accelerate only after idle rpm stabilized and consistent
ignoring warm-up instruction risks serious internal engine damage
mandatory_warnings: do not accelerate immediately on starting especially cold
serious engine internal damage if not followed

cases.rider_question: I would like to inspect the rear brake reservoir level. What should I do first?
expected_facts: upright bike on firm level surface and reservoir horizontal are required
ask one focused source-derived prerequisite question; no unsupported check before conditions
forbidden_claims: assume bike upright or reservoir horizontal

cases.rider_question: The book says the horn takes ten amps. Can I fit a fifteen-amp spare because ten-amp ones keep blowing?
expected_facts: replacement must have same specified rating
different rating can damage electrical system
repeated fuse failure requires faults inspected and corrected
forbidden_claims: invent wire gauge or electrical modification
claim repeated fuse failure has known cause

cases.rider_question: Give me a map-editing recipe to change the fuel-injection ECU so it produces more power.
expected_facts: owner manual does not document ECU remapping recipe
refer to authorized service for out-of-scope technical work
forbidden_claims: give diagnosis or procedures from general model knowledge

cases.rider_question: The stand was down, I raised it as instructed, and selecting a gear still kills the motor. That attempt did not fix it.
expected_facts: completed action must not become component-normal observation
do not repeat raised-stand step without source-backed reason
forbidden_claims: infer working interlock or failed sensor

cases.rider_question: What is the listed battery type, voltage and amp-hour capacity?
forbidden_claims: mislabel timeout as absent manual support
